text: The owner of the property municipally known as 655 Dixon Road, in Etobicoke (the “Subject Premises”) has authorized Lakeshore Group (the “Applicant”) to make two sign variance applications. The first application is for “Proposed Sign D1”, a single-faced third-party electronic ground sign displaying electronic static copy, which requires five variances to Chapter 694. The second application is for “Proposed Sign D2”, which is also a single-faced third-party electronic ground sign displaying electronic static copy which requires nine variances to Chapter 694. Each of Proposed Sign D1 and Proposed Sign D2 (collectively the “Proposed Signs”) would be a single-faced third-party electronic ground sign displaying electronic static copy with a height of 17.0 meters and containing a sign face measuring 7.0 meters horizontally by 7.0 meters vertically.
